UPSC CDS-II Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the admit card for Combined Defence Service CDS II posts. This recruitment was released for for 451 posts. The online application process for UPSC CDS-II Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 20 May 2026, to 11 June 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 13 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSC CDS-II Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 May 2026
  • Last Date : 11 June 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 03 September 2026
  • Result : Will be updated here soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • Female All Category : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC CDS-II Admit Card 2026?

UPSC CDS-II Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 11 June 2026 (Extended).

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://upsc.gov.in/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
